seoTitle: Per Diem Allowance Calculator for Business Trips
metaDescription: Compute a travel daily allowance from departure and return times, your day rates and meals provided.
intro: Trip allowance from 24-hour blocks, a part-day band and meal deductions.
why:
Daily allowances depend on destination and trip length. Enter your own full-day rate, part-day rate and the cut for each meal provided.

The model is deliberately simple: 24-hour blocks plus one part-day band. Official systems differ, so no rates are built in.
howTo: Enter day rates and the part-day threshold.
